SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT TT.*, CASE WHEN TT.EQUIPTCODETEMP IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE TT.EQUIPTCODETEMP END AS EQUIPTCODE FROM (SELECT A.*, D.EQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTCODETEMP, M.MAXELNTMPLID, S1.SOLNAME AS SOL1NAME, S2.SOLNAME AS SOL2NAME, S1.SOLNO AS SOL1NO, S2.SOLNO AS SOL2NO, R.REAGENTNAME FROM T_EMC_RUN A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON A.EQUIPTID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD M ON A.METHODID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SOL S1 ON A.SOL1ID = S1.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SOL S2 ON A.SOL2ID = S2.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_REAGENT R ON A.REAGENTID = R.ID) TT) T
AND
AND (CHARINDEX(',' + #{checkUserId} + ',' , ',' + T.CHECKUSERID + ',') > 0 OR T.CHECKUSERID IS NULL OR T.CHECKUSERID = '')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS = 'audit' AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND OT.PROJID = #{projId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS = 'done' AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND OT.PROJID = #{projId} )
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.RUNID = T.ID and OT.PROJID = #{projId})
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, C.EQUIPTNAME ASSISTEQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTCODE FROM T_EMC_RUN T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT C ON T.ASSISTEQUIPTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT D ON T.EQUIPTID = D.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, C.SLOPE RN2, C.INTERCEPT RN3, C.COEFFICIENT RN4 FROM T_EMC_RUN A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CURVE C ON A.CURVEID = C.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID
